Final Answer: 0.0325

To calculate the annual return, we use the formula:

$$
\text{Annual Return} = \frac{\text{Ending Price} - \text{Beginning Price}}{\text{Beginning Price}}
$$

Plugging in the given values:

$$
\text{Annual Return} = \frac{117.73 - 114.02}{114.02} = \frac{3.71}{114.02} \approx 0.0325
$$

Next, we calculate the Sharpe Ratio using the formula:

$$
\text{Sharpe Ratio} = \frac{\text{Annual Return} - \text{Risk-Free Rate}}{\text{Standard Deviation of Returns}}
$$

Given the risk-free rate is 2.52% (0.0252) and the standard deviation is 18.72
